He’s got a family of women he’s been close with since he was little.

There’s Yuuko his classmate, Asami the college model, and Mahiru the teacher.

item.title: Onago Life 2
item.description:

  • ブランド: Rojiurakan
  • 発売日: 2018-06-03
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 女子人生2
  • 英語名: Onago Life 2

あらすじ

Suzuki Tadashi is a gloomy, lazy guy working at a bottom-tier publisher.

Out of nowhere, he gets a super smart and gorgeous girlfriend: Mizuho Hakozaki.

He tries his best to be the kind of man who deserves her, but everything backfires.

A tragic death comes for Tadashi… or so it seems…

But then he wakes up as his own girlfriend—he’s become Mizuho Hakozaki!
